description: RouteProcessor2.processRoute issues transferFrom(from, pool, amount) where pool is taken from caller-supplied route data without validating it against a UniswapV3Factory pair. Any address that had granted the router an allowance was vulnerable: an attacker could call processRoute with pool = attacker-controlled and pull approved tokens directly. Affected 14 chains; whitehat counter-exploit recovered most funds. The canonical mainnet exploit_tx here is the 100-WETH pull from @0xsifu's approval that the Steve Ng / Hacken / SolidityScan post-mortems all cite as the example transaction.
